title: Verify: validateWorld scene character reference unit tests
summary: Unit tests for rejecting unknown and accepting known scene character ids
description: Add tests to game/tests/validator.test.ts calling validateWorld with in-memory worlds built from the validWorld and validScene fixtures in game/tests/fixtures/valid-world.ts. No filesystem, network or real dependencies.
acceptance_criteria: A scene with an unknown character id yields the exact path-tagged message
A scene whose characters are all in the world list yields no errors
A scene without characters yields no character error

steps.symbol: new: it('reports unknown scene character id with a path tag')
steps.action: Add a test in a new describe 'validateWorld scene characters' that builds a scene from validScene (id 'bedroom') with characters [{id:'ghost', name:'Ghost', position:{x:0,y:0}, scale:1, layer:'characters', animations:{idle:{asset:'a', animation:'idle'}}}], calls validateWorld({ ...validWorld, scenes: [scene] }) and asserts the errors contain 'scenes[bedroom].characters[0].id: unknown character ghost'.
steps.command: cd game && npx vitest run tests/validator.test.ts -t 'unknown scene character'
steps.expected: Test passes and the errors array contains the path-tagged message

steps.symbol: new: it('accepts scene characters all in the world list')
steps.action: Add a test using a scene with characters [{id:'boy', ...same required fields}] where validWorld.characters lists boy; assert validateWorld({ ...validWorld, scenes: [scene] }) toEqual [].
steps.command: cd game && npx vitest run tests/validator.test.ts -t 'all in the world list'
steps.expected: Test passes and validateWorld returns an empty array
